blocks.text: ROME, Italy—Security forces are deploying massively in Italy on Saturday for protests planned in eight cities including Rome and Milan after some demonstrations turned violent last weekend. The demonstrations come amid a wave of protests by students, truck drivers and farmers over budget cuts and cost of living issues like housing and fuel prices. Rome’s police force said in a statement it would “saturate both physical and virtual territory” and make use of drones and helicopters to monitor the demonstrations.
